Intact Investment Management Has Upped Holding in Transcanada (TRP) as Shares Declined; Evergreen Capital Management Continues to Hold Holding in Globalstar (GSAT) 
April 20, 2018 - By Darrin Black 
Evergreen Capital Management Llc increased its stake in Globalstar Inc (GSAT) by 63.74% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Evergreen Capital Management Llc bought 668,075 shares as the company’s stock declined 47.06% with the market. The institutional investor held 1.72 million shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.25 million, up from 1.05M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Evergreen Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Globalstar Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $995.08 million market cap company. The stock increased 4.12% or $0.0312 during the last trading session, reaching $0.7878. About 2.41M shares traded. Globalstar, Inc. (NYSEMKT:GSAT) has declined 57.71% since April 20, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 69.26% the S&P500. 
Intact Investment Management Inc increased its stake in Transcanada Corp (TRP) by 79.12% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Intact Investment Management Inc bought 209,800 shares as the company’s stock declined 16.00% with the market. The institutional investor held 474,980 shares of the natural gas distribution company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $29.05M, up from 265,180 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Intact Investment Management Inc who had been investing in Transcanada Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $37.17 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.85% or $0.82 during the last trading session, reaching $43.61. About 2.05 million shares traded or 29.22% up from the average. TransCanada Corporation (NYSE:TRP) has declined 12.65% since April 20, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 24.20% the S&P500. 
Among 13 analysts covering TransCanada Corporation ( NYSE:TRP ), 11 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 2 Hold. Therefore 85% are positive. TransCanada Corporation had 28 analyst reports since August 4, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. Morgan Stanley maintained the shares of TRP in report on Friday, February 9 with “Overweight” rating. As per Thursday, March 31, the company rating was upgraded by Citigroup. The rating was downgraded by Zacks to “Hold” on Thursday, August 6. On Friday, October 23 the stock rating was initiated by BMO Capital Markets with “Outperform”. Citigroup maintained it with “Buy” rating and $68 target in Wednesday, March 28 report. The stock of TransCanada Corporation (NYSE:TRP) has “Overweight” rating given on Tuesday, December 15 by JP Morgan. The firm earned “Sector Perform” rating on Tuesday, August 4 by Scotia Capital. TheStreet downgraded the stock to “Buy” rating in Saturday, August 15 report. The firm has “Buy” rating by Bank of America given on Thursday, September 1. The rating was downgraded by Wells Fargo on Thursday, March 22 to “Market Perform”. 
Intact Investment Management Inc, which manages about $2.49B US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Canadian Nat Res Ltd (NYSE:CNQ) by 403,800 shares to 1.06M shares, valued at $47.53M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Alphabet Inc by 310 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 1,800 shares, and cut its stake in Cott Corp Que (NYSE:COT). 
Evergreen Capital Management Llc, which manages about $988.53M US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Nordstrom Inc (NYSE:JWN) by 69,449 shares to 215,232 shares, valued at $10.20 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Western Gas Partners Lp (NYSE:WES) by 11,321 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 217,453 shares, and cut its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL).
